title: Journey of Abraham — System Preview
subtitle: A short guided tour proving camera movement, Scripture references, route animation, and artistic traveler markers before the researched Genesis batch is added.

chapters.title: Ur
chapters.description: The story engine can anchor a chapter to a historical place, move the map camera, and surface Scripture references while keeping interpretation metadata separate.

chapters.title: Toward Haran and Canaan
chapters.description: The glowing path and traveler are intentionally presented as a reconstruction. In the production atlas, known textual sequence and inferred physical route are separately encoded and cited.

chapters.title: Shechem and the Hill Country
chapters.description: Selecting a place demonstrates the production information model: geographic identification, historical interpretation, Scripture references, provenance, and an explicit explanation of why the marker is shown.
